BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Don Profundo!!
T-t-there it is, there it is! The boss of the\nmonsters!!
I'm Don Profundo, the boss of the Profundos.\nThis is Profundo's territory...I'll show no mercy\nto those who disturb our peace!!
We have the same ancestor. Let's not fight anymore\nbecause it's pointless. I'd appreciate it if you\ncould tell me why you're here.
I didn't know that you think of us as family.\nI apologize because I have been rude to you.
Unknown monsters invaded the deep sea zone we\nProfundos live in and we had to leave because of\nthat...
We won't cause the Ranas any trouble, so please\nlet us live here until the deep sea zone settles\ndown.
If that's the case, I would like to do something\nto help...
Hey, why don't you talk to the councilors?
Hmm...I don't really wanna talk to them, but\nI can't ignore those who have lost their homes.\nI bet the council wouldn't be so heartless either.
Please wait for the time being.
Thank you. It's nothing but please take this.
There seems to be not much oxygen left in your\nOxystones. It won't be enough for you to get to\nthe deep zone.
You have received a Concentrated Oxystone from\nDon Profundo!
T-thanks...Hm, I bet those Rana councilors still\ndon't really trust us. Look how they treat us...
Okay whatever. Let's go back to report to them!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back!
Explore this place a little longer!
